extShortName.description: Short name for the toolbar and chrome://extensions.

planPro.description: Pro tier badge and lock chip label.

proLockedTitle.description: Title tooltip on locked-but-visible Pro buttons.

extDesc.message: One click finds a free, legally-posted full-text copy of the paper you are viewing and saves it to your private citation library.

popupChecking.description: Live resolver step label in the popup. $1 is the resolver name (Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv).

popupReadingPage.description: Spinner label while the service worker fetches the active tab HTML.

popupStepsAria.description: aria-label on the four-step resolver rail in the popup.

popupFoundVia.description: Success detail line naming the resolver or host that yielded the free copy. $1 is the resolver or host name.

popupCheckedAll.message: Checked Unpaywall, OpenAlex, Crossref, and arXiv.
popupCheckedAll.description: Honest detail line under the not-found state: the whole chain ran.

popupSavedToLibrary.description: Detail line confirming a machine-written library row exists for this sighting.

popupFound.message: Free copy found. It opened in a new tab.
popupFound.description: Success state after a resolver hit; the PDF tab is already open.

popupFoundCached.description: Same-day cache hit state; offers Open free copy again.

popupOpenAgain.description: Button on a same-day cache hit; re-opens the PDF without spending a lookup.

popupCheckAgain.description: Forces a fresh resolver chain run; counts toward the free daily cap.

popupNotFound.message: No free legal copy found for this paper.
popupNotFound.description: Chain exhausted, DOI known. Never routes anywhere.

popupDoiUnknown.message: We could not find this DOI in open indexes.

popupNoDoi.message: No DOI found on this page.
popupNoDoi.description: Head parse found no DOI meta tag or doi.org href.

popupPageUnreadable.message: Could not read this page. Try reloading it, then click again.
popupPageUnreadable.description: Page fetch failed or was bot-walled.

popupUnsupported.message: PaperFetch works on paper and article pages.
popupUnsupported.description: chrome://, Web Store, and PDF viewer tabs are unsupported.

popupOffline.description: All resolver fetches failed with transport errors.

popupFreeCounter.description: Popup footer counter line. $1 used today, $2 FREE_DAILY_CAP.

popupLibraryFull.message: Library full. Upgrade or manage library.
popupLibraryFull.description: 26th distinct DOI on free: resolution still completes, row is skipped.

popupUpgrade.description: Upgrade CTA; opens the canonical checkout URL with per-surface utm_content.

popupMaybeLater.description: Dismisses any upsell. Always one click away, always respected.

popupProPrice.description: Static price line inside the popup upsell card. Literal $ is escaped as $$.

popupProTeaser.message: Pro adds unlimited lookups, site auto-detect, and one-click copy.
popupProTeaser.description: Locked-but-visible teaser line in the popup on the free tier. Informational, not an ask.

popupRecentTitle.description: Heading of the recent library strip in the popup.

popupOpenLibrary.description: Link from the popup to the options page library.

popupAutoDetect.description: Pro only. Requests ONE origin grant from a click handler, never at install.

popupCopyDoi.description: Pro convenience. Copies the normalized DOI to the clipboard.

popupCopyCitation.description: Pro convenience. Copies a formatted citation to the clipboard.

optionsLibraryTitle.description: Options page heading for the machine-written library.

optionsPageSub.message: Every paper you check is saved here on this device, with its citation data.
optionsPageSub.description: Sub-line under the options page heading. Local-first reassurance.

optionsLibCount.description: Library row count next to the filters. $1 is the visible row count.

optionsNoResults.description: Zero-hit line for library search and filter combinations.

optionsSearchPlaceholder.description: Library search input placeholder. Case-insensitive substring match.

optionsFilterFound.description: Library filter: rows with a free copy.

optionsFilterNotFound.description: Library filter: rows without a free copy.

optionsFilterGroupAria.description: aria-label on the found / not-found filter chip group.

optionsColStatus.description: Visually hidden library table column heading for the found dot.

optionsColHost.description: Library table column heading: first-seen page host.

optionsColSaved.description: Library table column heading: when the row was last seen.

optionsColActions.description: Visually hidden library table column heading for row actions.

optionsEmptyText.message: Open any paper page and click the PaperFetch icon. The result and its citation data land here automatically.

optionsClearConfirmBody.message: This deletes every paper in your library. Type DELETE to confirm.
optionsClearConfirmBody.description: Type-to-confirm copy for clear-all. The word DELETE stays in English caps as the confirmation token.

optionsClearConfirmPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and aria-label for the clear-all confirmation input.

optionsClearConfirmBtn.description: Confirm button for the type-to-confirm clear-all panel.

optionsExportBibtex.description: Free tier export. One .bib file, all or filtered rows.

optionsExportEmpty.message: Nothing to export yet. Open a paper page and click the PaperFetch icon first.
optionsExportEmpty.description: Status line shown when an export is clicked with an empty library.

optionsExportBoth.description: Pro bulk export: BibTeX and CSL-JSON in one click.

optionsDeleteRow.description: Per-row library delete. The library is machine-written; rows are never edited.

optionsLicenseActivate.description: Runs the feature-gate verify with timeout and offline grace.

optionsProActive.description: Shown after a successful license verify.

optionsGrantsTitle.description: Grant manager: lists runtime-granted origins, per-origin revoke.

optionsGrantsHint.message: On sites you enable, PaperFetch checks paper pages as they load and shows the result on the toolbar icon. Enable a site from the popup while you are on it.

optionsGrantsGate.description: Free-tier note in the grant manager. Show, do not hide.

optionsUpgradeLink.description: Anchor to the canonical checkout URL with utm_content=options.

optionsLicenseHelp.message: Verifying contacts the license server once, only when you click Activate. Nothing else about you or your browsing leaves this device.
optionsLicenseHelp.description: Privacy reassurance under the license key input.

optionsLicenseChecking.description: License verify in-progress label on the Activate button.

optionsLicenseInvalid.message: That key could not be verified. Check it and try again.
optionsLicenseInvalid.description: License verify failure line under the input.

optionsRevoke.description: Removes one origin grant and clears its badges.

footerHome.description: Visible footer text link on popup, options, and onboarding. Bare zovo.one, never /pricing.
